audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 against 51.19% over 672 games. The whole lane is a range tax: Annie's longest offensive spell is Disintegrate at 625 and Incinerate at 600, against Aurora's 900-range Q, and she has no dash. Only level 6 flips, because Tibbers off a stocked Pyromania is a genuine 600-range all-in.

Spikes are keyed to real numbers: Tibbers 130/115/100 at 600 range, Pyromania restocking on four of her own casts, and Aurora's first item landing the rotation from 900 while Annie still has to close to 625. The single-row flip at level 6 matches the packet levelChart exactly.

The decisive interaction is stated correctly and precisely: Pyromania stocks after four spell casts of Annie's own, not off hits landed, so the glow under her feet is the tell rather than anything Aurora does. The Molten Shield item from missingInteractions is already handled in phases[3].why, whys[3] and dontsFull[1].d — it is a 10s shield that damages anyone striking her, so a full pattern into a fresh shield pays her twice; force it out with a Q first.
breakdown.cooldowns carries digits and the right hierarchy: Tibbers 130s rank 1 at 600 range, Q flat 4s, W flat 7s, Molten Shield flat 10s, plus the four-cast passive counter.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both Do's bodies were bleed: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim under 'Punish whiffs with the full pattern', and dosFull[2].d talked about a wasted Tibbers under the title 'Fight inside your R zone post-6'.
audit.why: In each case the title promises one thing and the body explains another, which a reader notices immediately.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d rewritten around the four-cast glow and her 4s Q; dosFull[2].d rewritten to be about the R zone.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E the step-up, Q-recast the slowed target, hop out — a full pattern she answered with a whiff.
edits.after: Her Q is 4s and her stun needs four casts — when the glow is spent, step in and land the whole rotation.

edits.before: Annie wastes Tibbers — that is a full 130 seconds at rank 1.
edits.after: The zone slows her walk to 625 and you cross it instantly.
